exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 6,989 live births registered from 2016 to 2018 in selected slums of Dhaka and Gazipur city corporations, Bangladesh
finding: Neonatal mortality rate was significantly lower for babies delivered by Caesarean section compared to those delivered vaginally.
mod_finding: Neonatal mortality rate was 2.7 times higher for vaginal deliveries compared to Caesarean deliveries (46 vs. 17 per 1,000 births).
